amendment_note: Analysis-only correction to protocol v1.4. Degree is reported through total conditional-function variance and cumulative low-degree concentration. The former effective-degree scalar is retained only as a derived diagnostic. No data profile or learner cell is recomputed.

paper.title: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs Models
paper.degree: cardinality |A| of the interacting context-position subset

variance_metric.loss: multiclass Brier risk for the next-token one-hot vector
variance_metric.L1: cross-fitted risk of the degree-at-most-1 additive projection
variance_metric.L2: cross-fitted risk of the degree-at-most-2 pair projection
variance_metric.monotonicity: risks are monotonized only when finite-sample cross-fit noise violates nesting
variance_metric.pair_selection: maximize V_pair among the ten frozen lag pairs

controlled_consistency_rule.status: post-hoc metric correction; consistency check, not a new independent confirmation test

scope.controlled_generators: the selected pair contains the complete planted parent set, so V_pair is the full conditional-function variance for the planted law
scope.natural_text: the estimate is the concentration of the strongest frozen two-lag conditional function only; it is not a full 64-position spectrum
scope.effective_degree: diagnostic identity 2-C_leq1 for a positive two-level decomposition; not a primary metric
